title: Sorvete de melancia ou melão congelado
creator: almanaquesos
statusNote: This reel tests a viral idea and gives no amounts.
steps: Halve the melon or watermelon, scoop out the seeds, cover with cling film and freeze.
Scrape and stir the frozen flesh with a spoon until it turns into a sorbet, eating it from the frozen shell. Ice-cold milk helps make it creamier.
